notes: A big reliability and combat pass. Modules are now crash-isolated and quarantined instead of taking the client down, configs save atomically with a backup, and AutoCrystal got camera-aware spot picking, reach-safe placement, faster re-arm and a proper break cycle. Anchor Macro re-arms after each detonation, the Account page now shows a clean spinning character, stats, K/D, refresh and clipboard API-key import with live market prices, and the GUI has a fixed scaling layout, animated dock, new Vidal icons and a cached text renderer.
